title: Oxygen Isotopes Reveal Low-mass Star Dominance in the Small Magellanic Cloud
question: Can the oxygen isotope ratios (especially 18O/17O) of molecular gas in the low-metallicity SMC be measured via C18O and C17O J=2-1 and what do they say about stellar enrichment and the galaxy-wide IMF

data.bands: Band 6, two frequency setups, 16 spectral windows in total (four used here)
data.arrays: Atacama Compact Array (ACA) for the main data; total-power (TP) data from 2015.1.00196.S
data.angular_resolution: Restoring beams 6.5x5.7 to 7.0x6.1 arcsec (Table 1); all data convolved to a common circular 7.5 arcsec beam
data.sensitivity: ACA noise 11, 10, 8, 4 mJy/beam at ~0.3 km/s channel width for 12CO, 13CO, C18O, C17O; TP ~0.5 Jy/beam (12CO, 13CO), ~0.4 Jy/beam (C18O) per 244 kHz channel

evidence.quote: at a distance of 62.1$\pm$1.9 kpc (cite: 2014ApJ...780...59G)

what.value: Line rest frequencies from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy

evidence.quote: suggested by the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (cite: 2016JMoSp.327...95E)
the background temperature, which is set to be 2.73 K (cite: 2009ApJ...707..916F)

what.value: SMC star formation history and low star formation rate (<0.3 Msun/yr over >~10 Gyr)

evidence.quote: the overall star formation rates were low, of order $<$0.3  M$_{\odot}$yr$^{-1}$ over the past $\gtrsim$10 Gyr (cite: 2004AJ....127.1531H)

what.value: Gaia census: number of high-mass stars lower by a factor of 3-7 than expected from the low-mass population

evidence.quote: finds the number of high-mass stars to be lower by a factor of 3–7 than expected from the low-mass population (cite: 2021A&A...646A.106S)

what.value: Literature oxygen isotope ratios for LMC, NGC 253, NGC 4945, M82, PKS 1830-211, NGC 3256, Arp 220, M83 and Milky Way regions (comparison table)

consistent with the high intensity ratios reported for N83C in the SMC (cite: 2017ApJ...844...98M)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image the ACA data
recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration in CASA, then manual tclean imaging
key_parameters: AUTO-MULTITHRESH masking, parameters as Kepley et al. 2020 Table 2
pixel size 1.1 arcsec, primary beam correction applied

recipe.goal: Add short spacings and match resolution
recipe.method: Feather TP 12CO and 13CO data with the ACA data, then convolve all lines to a common 7.5 arcsec beam; C18O and C17O stay ACA-only
assumptions: C18O and C17O ACA-only spectra have negligible missing flux at the peak position because they are compact

recipe.goal: Extract peak spectra and fit Gaussians
recipe.method: Extract spectra at the emission peak (13CO peak) and fit a Gaussian to each to get velocity, peak Tb, FWHM and integrated intensity
key_parameters: Integration velocity range 105-145 km/s for 12CO and 122-129 km/s for the other three lines
assumptions: 12CO and 13CO from ACA+TP; C18O and C17O from ACA-only

recipe.goal: Derive excitation temperature and optical depths
recipe.method: LTE radiative transfer with optically thick 12CO J=2-1: Tex from the 12CO peak brightness temperature, then optical depths of the isotopologues assuming the same Tex
key_parameters: Beam dilution factor f=1 (fiducial) or f=0.34 (source size 5.4 arcsec)
assumptions: LTE, 12CO optically thick, same Tex for all four lines

recipe.goal: Fit Tex and column densities with LTE MCMC
recipe.method: Weeds LTE spectral model fitted to the observed spectra with emcee; Tex and the 13CO, C18O, C17O column densities are fit
key_parameters: Velocities and FWHM fixed to Table 2 values; C17O FWHM set equal to C18O
assumptions: Single Gaussian component for all molecules
Same source size for all four lines
C17O line width set equal to C18O because Gaussian fit overestimates it owing to hyperfine splitting

recipe.method: Isotope ratios taken directly from the fitted column densities; 12CO integrated intensity ratios give only lower limits on 16O/18O and 16O/17O
assumptions: Oxygen isotopes not chemically fractionated; C18O and C17O optically thin

recipe.goal: Test sensitivity to the assumed source size
recipe.method: Repeat the MCMC fit with source size 5.4 arcsec (beam dilution factor 0.34) inferred from the compact C17O component

recipe.goal: Interpret ratios in terms of stellar enrichment and IGIMF
recipe.method: Compare the low 18O/17O and high 13CO/C18O with nucleosynthesis sources, SMC carbon-star fraction, Gaia high-mass star census and IGIMF predictions
assumptions: SMC ISM is well mixed so LIRS 36 may be representative (not established)

evidence.quote: yield only lower limits of $^{16}$O/$^{18}$O$\gtrsim$444 and $^{16}$O/$^{17}$O$\gtrsim$386, respectively.

score_reason: ALMA project codes, calibrators, CASA version, robust and key imaging choices and the MCMC recipe are given with numeric results, but masking parameters are by reference, there is no line-free/continuum-subtraction or feather detail, and no code is released.
rediscovery_reason: Both project codes are given and the main results are numeric (18O/17O = 0.87+/-0.26) from peak spectra and a simple LTE MCMC; public availability is not stated in the paper (inferred from ALMA archive norms), and some imaging and fit details would need to be reconstructed.
